title: Water-flora foundational growth architecture
scope: Foundational growth architecture of the K4 water-flora kingdom at qualitative strategy grain. Species, forms, chemistry, reproduction, salinity tolerances, the egg-substrate assignment, floating-branch existence, symbioses, Mana patterns, and local presence remain open.
approval_evidence: After the A/B/C architecture cards were presented with A recommended, the Author selected 'A — Anchor-and-streamer' on 2026-08-17.
question: What foundational growth architecture should define the K4 water-flora kingdom?
selection: Anchor-and-streamer flora: individual non-networked organisms with durable reserve-holding anchors gripping bed, stone, or bank, plus expendable seasonal streamer growth shed to ice, flood scouring, and grazing and regrown after the spring freshet. The kingdom spans submerged, floating-surface, and wet-margin emergent forms, with mature anchored forms as the natural but unassigned candidate for the lake's sturdy egg-substrate plants.
alternatives: K4-ARCH-A: persistent anchors with expendable streamers; selected.
K4-ARCH-B: buoyant vessel flora with seasonal sinking; not selected (weak sturdy-substrate fit, freshet exposure).
K4-ARCH-C: dense clonal turf meadows; not selected (blurs K1 and K5 identities).
rationale: The anchor-and-streamer architecture survives the established freshet-and-ice regime with the least special pleading, makes the sturdy egg-substrate connection natural without forcing the assignment, spans all three K4 habits, and keeps the individual-organism contrast with K1 crisp.
consequences: K4 members are individual organisms of anchor plus expendable streamer growth.
Winter and flood survival is anchor-and-reserves survival; anchor loss is the lasting damage.
Kingdom rhythms couple to the freshet, high-water margins, summer growth, and winter ice or die-back.
Mature anchored forms are the standing candidate for the egg-substrate plants pending their own record.
Later lake flora, nursery, forage, and fishery development must build on this architecture.
No Earth-plant homology, human practice, guaranteed harvest, or System mechanic is created.
residual_unknowns: Species, forms, dimensions, silhouettes, and lifespan remain open.
Anchor and streamer anatomy, chemistry, reserves, and material properties remain open.
Energy capture, reproduction, dispersal, and seasonal timing mechanisms remain open.
Whether the egg-substrate plants are anchored K4 members requires its own record.
Salinity tolerances toward the brackish coast remain open.
Floating-branch existence and form remain open.
Symbioses, grazing relationships, pests, diseases, and Mana patterns remain open.
Human uses, practices, and knowledge remain open.
reopening_conditions: The architecture cannot support required lake ecology or nursery functions.
A concrete contradiction with an accepted or provisional record emerges.
The Author explicitly reopens the decision.
